notes.notes:

notes.title: Playtesting ends on December 1 and will restart in January 2025.
notes.notes: Playtesting ends on December 1 and will restart in January 2025. There will be Chances to help improve the game before the launch. 2nd round of playtesting will begin in late January 2025.

notes.title: The Multiplayer playtest will start on November 15.
notes.notes:
The Multiplayer playtest will start on November 15. Its purpose is to test multiplayer and find any problems or bugs that need fixing.  

There be 
2 Sky battle maps( 4 and 2 teams).
8 Dodgeball maps.
21 Dodgeball types.
Sandbox multiplayer mode.
